These files go in the repo folder  .github/workflows/  (a hidden folder; on GitHub use "Add file > Upload files" inside that folder, or create the files in the web editor with the path .github/workflows/<name>).
gds.yaml, docs.yaml, fpga.yaml : CMOS5L versions (action tag @ttihp27a as in the organisers' template of 3 Nov 2026, pdk ihp-sg13cmos5l) - put these on a separate branch.
pio-tests.yaml : current version (random start-up step, per-seed results); same for both branches.
